notes: Greybox feel gate before art: play the course on part-built fallbacks first. Obstacle data lives in GardenConfig.DASH (GARDEN-008); tuning it is not an economy change (decision 0012 Consequences). Contract points settled in code, for GARDEN-011: (1) garden.md says obstacles are parked; DashFx destroys them after each round and rebuilds them on entry, so models that load late are picked up. (2) garden.md says PivotTo at the pose; the sweeper is lifted 2 studs because its pose sits on the deck while DashRules hits 0 to 6 above it. (3) DashFx scales models by their measured bounding box, not GardenAssets[name].size. (4) Live place is not in the GDD or remotes: it is a client estimate from replicated root positions; the results card uses only dashFinish. (5) egg_celestial is not in CLIENT_MODELS, so the reveal uses a client copy of the bed's mesh egg and a ball before the upload. (6) Collision group needs no client code: Dash.track joins characters on the server and platforms stay in Default. (7) Reduced motion reads GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled; the game has no setting of its own and no camera shake. Also changed for QA items: Menu ask spaces every request 0.4 s apart (replacing the buy-then-equip wait), action stacks real button widths, and panels widen below 900 px so 18 px text fits.
